declared_inputs.participant: per-task committed oracle solution (solution.sh | solution.yaml stream) — $0, no model calls
declared_inputs.subject_machinery: hh-env EnvDriver/Dispatcher/compact/seal on podman cells (--network none, hh-helper)

machinery_bounds.cell_network: none — solutions/verifiers needing live egress cannot genuinely run inside the cell
machinery_bounds.derived_base_images: per-task FROM <client> + the packages the task's own scripts install (recorded verbatim in the slot/build records)

assumptions: outcome-blind eligibility; exclusions published before outcomes
equal within-stratum weights; seeded sampling without replacement
task-level fair lane coin; identical lanes; five interleaved rounds

verdict_basis: 160/300 slots executed with a real receipt (130 resolved / 30 unresolved); 140 inconclusive, 0 failed, 0 unattempted; 32/60 first-subject slots executed (26 resolved). Denominators retained verbatim.
